description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans cluster client connection retry logic, including a test class 'ClusterClientTests' with a specific test 'ConnectIsRetryableTest' that verifies the retry behavior when connecting to a cluster. It also defines a mock gateway provider class used within the test.

classes.name: ClusterClientTests
classes.description: A test class for Orleans cluster client connection retry logic, including setup and a specific test for retry behavior.

classes.name: MockGatewayListProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of IGatewayListProvider used within the test to simulate gateway list behavior.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides the configuration of the test cluster to set connection transport to TCP socket.

methods.name: ConnectIsRetryableTest
methods.description: Unit test verifying that the ClusterClient can retry connection attempts when initial connection fails.

methods.name: RetryFunc
methods.description: A delegate function used as a retry filter, which adds the gateway endpoint upon encountering a SiloUnavailableException.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, here returning a completed task.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns the current list of gateways.
